title: The Roberge-Weiss transition as a probe for conformality in many-flavor QCD
summary: We consider the problem of identifying the onset of the conformal window for QCD with $N_f$ massless flavors in the fundamental representation, and propose a new effective method to determine it from lattice simulations. This method is based on the investigation of the so-called Roberge-Weiss transition temperature $T_{RW}$, which is encountered at specific values of the imaginary baryon chemical potential, and can also be interpreted as the inverse of the critical spatial size at which charge conjugation is spontaneously broken in a finite box.
